name: codex-claude-delegation
description: Deterministically delegate token-heavy read-only Codex work to a local Claude CLI subprocess.

interface.shortDescription: Delegate large read-only work to Claude CLI with token-saving metrics.
interface.longDescription: Adds deterministic gates for large files, directories, URLs, read-only commands, and long task context. Codex sees only concise JSON decisions and Claude summaries while local artifacts keep the raw evidence.
defaultPrompt: Use Claude delegation before reading a large PRD, log, diff, or directory.
Run the delegation preflight and explain whether this machine is ready.
